items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1957-08-04
items.q: I played with all them boys, Zachary's a player, on 3rd Street Day... Kid Punch, he, he, he's a strong corner player, because I was playing out too, and Kid Punch taking the, he was playing with the brass band, in the, my brass band

ctx.x: that started up, I was a young man that time, you know, of course, I didn't mean to be 69 years old, won't mean to shave, I'll be glad, Mr. Russell. You don't look like that. Yeah, well, I'll be glad to see that, and experience life, and I know what it's all about, you know, of course, these days in time, well, everybody was free, everybody owned a penny, hot to play, hot not to play, well, you see, in them times, we used to play card drills, pokers, mazookas, lancers, shatters, and warsers.
